subject.title: fix: allow configuring Slack App Home copy

question: Should OpenClaw add a new Slack `appHome` config surface for branded App Home copy and disabling Home publishing, or should this PR be narrowed to correcting the fallback slash-command copy only?
rationale: The PR solves a real mismatch, but it expands the public Slack configuration surface and operator behavior, which the repository policy treats as product- and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Approve bounded `appHome` config
options.body: Accept the new config surface after the branch fixes SDK exports, generated metadata/UI hints, docs, tests, and real Slack proof.

options.title: Narrow to fallback copy
options.body: Reject the new config block for now and only make the default Home description honor `slashCommand.name`.

options.title: Defer App Home branding policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide a broader Slack App Home customization model.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded `appHome` config
recommendation.body: Accept the new config surface after the branch fixes SDK exports, generated metadata/UI hints, docs, tests, and real Slack proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the landed App Home implementation and the current handler surface this PR extends.
